d: The IT Infrastructure and Cloud Solutions Section Head is responsible for leading and managing the organization’s enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, systems administration, and IT Service Desk operations. The role ensures the availability, reliability, scalability, performance, and continuity of compute, storage, virtualization, backup, systems, and hybrid cloud services.

The position oversees infrastructure and systems architecture, cloud adoption, capacity planning, lifecycle management, disaster recovery, system administration, monitoring, maintenance, and technical support. It also manages IT Service Desk operations, including incident and service request management, user support, troubleshooting, escalation, and service-level compliance, while ensuring alignment with organizational policies, IT standards, and cybersecurity requirements.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology
A minimum of 6 years of relevant experience with at least 4 years in a similar role
r: li
Lead the development of technical competencies and capabilities within the Infrastructure and Cloud Solutions Section to align with current and future business requirements.
li
Mentor and coach team members to strengthen technical expertise, leadership capability, and career progression.
li
Lead and manage the Infrastructure and Cloud Solutions Section, including team supervision, performance management, and professional development.
li
Develop section objectives, technology roadmap, and annual work plans aligned with organizational goals and IT strategy.
li
Allocate resources, coordinate vendors, support CAPEX/OPEX planning, and monitor team, vendor, and service performance.
li
Establish and maintain policies, procedures, standards, and technical baselines for infrastructure and cloud services.
li
Infrastructure Architecture & Design: Oversee architecture, scalability planning, and implementation of compute, storage, virtualization, HCI, backup, and related platform services.
li
Cloud Solutions: Lead the design, adoption, migration, and optimization of private, public, and hybrid cloud solutions, including but not limited to IaaS/PaaS and Microsoft and Oracle platforms.
li
Automation & Standardization: Promote automation, standard provisioning, configuration consistency, and operational efficiency across infrastructure platforms.
li

IT Service Desk: Oversee IT Service Desk operations, ensuring effective incident and service request management, user support, timely resolution, escalation, and compliance with defined service levels.

d: The Sales Specialist is responsible for executing sales strategies and achieving quarterly and annual sales targets. The role also involves engaging with clients to present available land opportunities through sales presentations and demonstrations, negotiating and closing deals, and managing customer relationships to maximize future sales opportunities and ensure customer satisfaction.
q: Diploma or bachelor’s degree in business administration, marketing, or equivalent .
Minimum of 2 years of experience in real estate sales.
r: li
Achieve approved quarterly and annual sales targets.
li
Execute approved sales plans and programs to attract prospective customers and maximize sales opportunities.
li
Communicate with customers through various channels, including telephone, digital platforms, and face-to-face meetings.
li
Deliver professional sales presentations and explain the investment advantages and value proposition of available land opportunities.
li
Coordinate and follow up with relevant departments to complete sales processes and ensure the efficient closing of transactions.
li
Build and maintain long-term professional relationships with existing and prospective customers to support future sales opportunities.
li
Handle customer inquiries, feedback, and complaints effectively, and provide appropriate solutions to ensure customer satisfaction.
li
Prepare and submit periodic reports to the Sales and Marketing Manager, including sales performance indicators, completed transactions, and updates on prospective customers.
li
Maintain and regularly update customer records to ensure the accuracy and integrity of information.
li
Document customer feedback and recommendations and utilize them to improve products and services.
li
Monitor and analyse competitors’ offerings and pricing and provide relevant observations and recommendations.
li
Track and assess real estate market trends and developments, identifying potential opportunities and challenges.
li
Collaborate with the Marketing team in developing and implementing promotional campaigns and marketing initiatives that support the achievement of sales objectives.
